notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Bloom Tender to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Bloom Tender triggers, causing you to loot.
Telekinetic Bonds triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U} to untap Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control a black and/or red permanent, this combo makes near-infinite mana of those color(s).
